text: Meet Tandem. A little common ground for people planning a trip together. Everyone has different priorities. Tandem gives each traveller a personal companion, so those differences can shape one shared plan. First, your agent gets to know you.

Choose the experiences you enjoy, rank what matters most, and decide when your agent should ask you before suggesting a compromise. These answers guide your companion. They don't replace the specific limits you confirm for each trip.
Create a trip, meet your companion, and invite your friends. Each person has their own agent, with a distinct colour and voice. Together, they form the planning room.
The agent turns your idea into a trip brief. You confirm the destination and dates before planning continues.

Now the conversation becomes personal. Share your departure airport, budget, baggage needs, and anything that would make the trip work better for you. Your agent records what you say and asks you to confirm it. Private reasons stay in your own conversation.

With everyone's details confirmed, the agents can research flights and compare options. The shared discussion brings their findings together, while each companion checks what a proposal means for its own traveller.
When a trade-off needs your decision, your companion asks privately. You remain in control.

Finally, everyone reviews the proposed plan. Flight prices and sources are visible, and each traveller gives their own approval. An agent's recommendation is not the final decision. This walkthrough ends with the group agreeing to the plan. Tandem helps people find common ground, while keeping a voice, and a final say, for everyone.
